newReleases.name: Hear With Eyes
newReleases.desc:
Hear with Eyes

How much of a conversation can you understand without relying on sound?

Hear with Eyes is an interactive quiz game that lets hearing users experience one aspect of deaf and hard-of-hearing communication through lip reading. Instead of simply explaining the challenges of lip reading, the app invites you to experience them firsthand.

Watch short lip movement animations and guess the spoken word using visual information. A faint, muffled audio cue is available, but the primary source of information is what you see—not what you hear.

Features

• Four difficulty levels from Easy to Extreme

• Progressive gameplay that encourages observation and inference

• Replay-based scoring system that rewards careful listening and viewing

• Clean and intuitive interface designed for focused learning

• Fully playable without relying on audio

Why Hear with Eyes?

Many people assume that sign language is the primary communication method for all deaf individuals. In reality, many deaf and hard-of-hearing people also use lip reading, spoken language, writing, gestures, or a combination of communication methods.

Hear with Eyes was created to encourage empathy through direct experience rather than explanation.

This app is not intended to replicate the lived experience of deaf or hard-of-hearing individuals. Instead, it offers an opportunity to better understand some of the cognitive effort involved in lip-reading–based communication.

Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.
